description: Source code for the HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema class, defining configuration directives, schemas, and related methods for HTMLPurifier.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema
classes.description: Class managing configuration schema, directives, and their defaults for HTMLPurifier.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Defines a configuration directive with specified namespace, name, default, type, and null allowance.

methods.name: addNamespace
methods.description: Defines a new namespace for directives.

methods.name: addValueAliases
methods.description: Defines value aliases for a directive.

methods.name: addAllowedValues
methods.description: Sets allowed values for a directive.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a directive for backward compatibility.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Replaces stdclass directives with type integers where applicable.

methods.name: makeFromSerial
methods.description: Unserializes and returns a ConfigSchema object from stored data.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the singleton instance of the configuration schema.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Deprecated method to define a directive, replaced by add().

methods.name: defineNamespace
methods.description: Deprecated method to define a namespace, replaced by addNamespace().

methods.name: defineValueAliases
methods.description: Deprecated method to define value aliases, replaced by addValueAliases().

methods.name: defineAllowedValues
methods.description: Deprecated method to define allowed values, replaced by addAllowedValues().

methods.name: defineAlias
methods.description: Deprecated method to define directive alias, replaced by addAlias().

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Deprecated method for validation, now uses HTMLPurifier_VarParser->parse().
